web-guide-idea-5.audience: Devotional music lovers looking for a small, warm performance.
web-guide-idea-5.offer: Offer a bhajan programme built around a theme, language or festival. Your voice, selection and introductions make it more personal than a background playlist.
web-guide-idea-5.steps.0: Choose songs you may perform and stream.
web-guide-idea-5.steps.1: Introduce each bhajan and perform a short prepared set.
web-guide-idea-5.steps.2: Invite a final request from the repertoire you have cleared.
web-guide-idea-5.equipment: A phone and quiet room are enough to start; use your usual harmonium or instrument if part of the performance. Test that loud passages do not distort.
web-guide-idea-5.returnReason: Develop festival editions or a regional bhajan series. Let listeners suggest the next theme rather than repeating the same set every time.
web-guide-idea-5.promotion: Share a short sample you have rights to perform, with the programme length and language.

web-guide-idea-5.metadataDescription: Create an intimate devotional music gathering with songs you have permission to perform and stream. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
